literal.prompt: В каком году произошло восстание декабристов?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The official event page identifies the Decembrist armed uprising as 14 (26) December 1825 in St Petersburg (L44); the same-category numeric distractors are independently explained as different events by their own-option notes: the 1812 war and campaigns (L45), Alexander II accession (L47), and serfdom emancipation (L51). The 1825 key is unique.
literalGroups.locator: President Library Decembrist page, L44, L45, L54-L56; President Library Alexander II page, L47, L51

literalGroups.literal: Восстание декабристов произошло 14 (26) декабря 1825 года в Санкт-Петербурге. Участники выступили против самодержавия и крепостного права во время династического кризиса после смерти Александра I.
literalGroups.primaryGround: L44 gives the dual-calendar date, location, and the aims of overthrowing autocracy, abolishing serfdom, and establishing representative government. L54-L56 describe Alexander I’s death, the interregnum, and the conspirators’ planned action, supporting the stated dynastic-crisis context.
literalGroups.locator: President Library Decembrist page, L44, L45, L54-L56

literalGroups.literal: Отечественная война 1812 года и заграничные походы русской армии стали отправной точкой для появления тайных декабристских обществ.
literalGroups.primaryGround: L45 calls the 1812 Patriotic War and the 1813-1814 Russian campaigns the starting point for the secret societies that preceded the Decembrists; the note accurately ties the 1812 option to that historical context.

literalGroups.literal: В 1855 году императором стал Александр II.
literalGroups.primaryGround: L47 states that Alexander II acceded to the Russian throne in 1855 after Nicholas I’s death.
literalGroups.locator: President Library Alexander II page, L47

literalGroups.literal: Восстание началось 14 (26) декабря 1825 года на Сенатской площади Санкт-Петербурга.
literalGroups.primaryGround: L44 states that the uprising took place on 14 (26) December 1825 on Senate Square in St Petersburg. The additional date and location facts go beyond the prompt’s year and key.

literalGroups.literal: В 1861 году в России отменили крепостное право.
literalGroups.primaryGround: L51 states that Alexander II signed the Emancipation Manifesto on 19 February (3 March) 1861, ending the serf dependency of peasants.
literalGroups.locator: President Library Alexander II page, L51

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.fullPrompt: В каком году произошло восстание декабристов?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.note: Отечественная война 1812 года и заграничные походы русской армии стали отправной точкой для появления тайных декабристских обществ.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.grammar: All four options are bare numerals, so each reads naturally as the answer to “В каком году…?”; the same prompt is retained for every substitution.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: The shared Russian prompt is grammatical with the bare four-digit year. 1812 is one of four same-category historical dates; the key remains 1825 because the official page dates the uprising to 14 (26) December 1825. The note gives a supported, useful connection between the 1812 war/campaigns and the origins of Decembrist societies.

absoluteDifficulty.audience: Russian-speaking adult audience with ordinary familiarity with national history
absoluteDifficulty.ground: The question requires recalling a specific date of a well-known Russian political event. Outside Russian history familiarity, the four prominent event-years mainly let a player narrow the options; among people who regularly encounter the topic, 1825 is a recognizable school-history fact. The four year options remain equally compact and same-category.
